issues.problem: Standalone analysis opens on a retained in-progress daily board without a running-clock marker. The fixture reproduction completes an ask through the worker and renders the result.
issues.fix: Require positive analysis evidence tied to the currently mounted main board and move list. Keep the gate closed while the previous game board remains mounted. Add a staggered daily-game fixture that asserts hidden UI and zero POSTs until the analysis board is ready.

issues.problem: A Retry-After countdown continues to update the panel after it is closed and the tab is hidden.
issues.fix: Keep the cooldown expiry in state and stop the display interval on close or hide. Recompute and resume the countdown when the error is visible. Test that a closed panel in a hidden tab performs no countdown writes.

issues.problem: Stepping to a different position during an animation disables the main ask buttons but leaves the previous result current and its Ask again action enabled beyond the update budget.
issues.fix: Mark the prior result stale or pending as soon as a changed board enters the reading state. Disable its result actions and offer the new re-ask once the board settles. Add a regression that starts with a displayed result.

issues.problem: The scanned-board renderer strips every move number from a supplied critical line.
issues.fix: Keep numbered SAN in the critical line and label its numbering as relative to the asked position when historical clocks are unknown. Keep the main headline free of placeholder move numbers.

issues.problem: Valid Retry-After durations over 600 seconds are shortened.
issues.fix: Keep the full server expiry and use that expiry for display and eligibility. Exercise a longer delta-seconds header and a longer HTTP-date header.

issues.problem: Chess.com variation replay depends on ancestry attributes that only the synthetic fixture demonstrates.
issues.fix: Capture actual subline markup from Game Review or Analysis. Implement and test the ancestry it exposes with full outbound assertions, while preserving the visible fallback where ancestry is unavailable.

issues.problem: The options axe evidence covers initial load, and the live-region fix has no regression for the region remaining rendered before its first message.
issues.fix: Assert that initially empty options alerts and statuses remain exposed, scan validation and save/remove states, and document the screen-reader walkthrough.

issues.problem: Gated views expose two Close controls with the same action.
issues.fix: Keep one visible Close action in gated views and update the navigation assertion.

issues.problem: The token warning says the credential accompanies every question even when the selected custom server has no token consent.
issues.fix: State that a saved token accompanies built-in server requests and accompanies custom requests only with explicit approval for that origin.

issues.problem: The required level-10 evidence of successful dashboard checks is missing.
issues.fix: Record the version and attach an owner screenshot of the Chrome Web Store dashboard passing the draft checks.
